DEFENDANTS' MOTION TO COMPEL FURTHER RESPONSES TO FORM INTERROGATORIES IS GRANTED IN PART AND DENIED IN PART. AS TO PLAINTIFFS' RESPONSES TO FORM INTERROGATORY 9.1, AS THE RESPONSES STATE THE VALUE OF THE MEAL SERVICE, THEY ARE ADEQUATE; AND THE MOTION IS DENIED. AS THE RESPONSES STATE THAT THE DETERMINATION OF AN AMOUNT FOR THE LOSS OF RENT CONTROLLED HOUSING, THE OBJECTIONS ARE OVERRULED; AND THE RESPONSES ARE INADEQUATE AS THEY RESPOND THAT THE AMOUNT IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN MARKET VALUE AND PLAINTIFF'S PRESENT RENT. A DOLLAR AMOUNT MUST BE STATED. WHILE PROOF OF DAMAGES MAY BE OFFERED THROUGH EXPERT TESTIMONY, THE AMOUNT IS A FACT WHICH MUST BE STATED. AS TO PLAINTIFFS' RESPONSES TO FORM INTERROGATORY NO. 17(A) AND (B), THE MOTION IS GRANTED. THE RESPONSES ARE INADEQUATE. EACH RESPONSE MUST BE SEPARATE FOR EACH REQUEST FOR ADMISSION AND EACH RESPONSE MUST INDEPENDENT AND SEPARATE WITHOUT REFERENCE TO OTHER DISCOVERY RESPONSES. FURTHER RESPONSES SHALL BE MADE WITHIN 15 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. ALL REQUESTS FOR SANCTIONS ARE DENIED. COMM: EVERETT A. HEWLETT
